answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable jade-sized stake before it can earn reputation, then slash that stake when audited work is fabricated or duplicated. A Sybil operator must immobilize capital for each account, so creating thousands of identities multiplies the attacker's upfront cost; honest agents recover their stake and earn fees. A crystal-clear audit trail can echo the same penalty across linked duplicate submissions without charging legitimate participation.
